solutions.title: Path map
solutions.strategy: Store directory children and file content in maps keyed by full path.

timeComplexity.explanation: Operations split path components and listing sorts d names.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Maps store all created paths and file content.

solutions.title: Trie nodes
solutions.strategy: Represent each path component as a trie node with sorted child names and optional file content.

timeComplexity.explanation: Traversal follows p components; directory listing sorts d child names.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The trie stores every component and file content once.
